portals.name: Abeokuta official registry / cadastral map sources
portals.operator: Official city, regional or national public authority, as described per source
portals.observation: The state land registry/admin office is physically in Abeokuta and the official portal lists Abeokuta schemes. The official OLARMS-GIS landing page advertises parcel polygons and cadastral maps, but entry is through a sign-in/start flow and no public terms or anonymous schema are supplied. A separate property-ID map advertises parcel click-through to PID/address; it was not used. No anonymous geometry-only endpoint was verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Ogun State’s official OLARMS portal describes state land registration/search and property-registration services, lists government land schemes in Abeokuta, and places the Bureau of Lands and Survey GIS office at Oke-Mosan, Abeokuta. This is city-located institutional evidence, not a claim of citywide parcel coverage.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous public geometry-only parcel response was verified.

technicalBlocker: The primary land-registry workflow requires account/transaction steps; the GIS landing page lacks an anonymous schema, and the public property-ID map exposes IDs/address on selection. No geometry-only public route was verified.
remainingUncertainty: Whether OLARMS-GIS has a public geometry-only endpoint separate from its sign-in/start workflow and property-identification map.
nextStep: If parcel geometry is needed, verify a distinct official public geometry-only feature service with a server-side allowlist before any point request.
